newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan distances itself from Korea defection row.
newsitem.headline: Japan distances itself from Korea defection row.

text.p: Japan said on Friday it would not get deeply involved in a dispute between the two Koreas over the defection of a senior North Korean official.
"We will watch the situation with great interest...but we will not go any further and get deeply involved," top government spokesman Seiroku Kajiyama told a news conference.
After a two-week visit to Japan, Hwang Jong-yop, a senior adviser to North Korean leader Kim Jong-il, flew to Beijing on Tuesday and the next day sought refuge in Seoul"s Beijing consulate.
North Korea has said it is inconceivable Hwang would seek asylum and that South Korea kidnapped him.
